wiki.title: Claire Cory
wiki.extract: Claire Cory (born September 11, 1998) is an American politician serving as a member of the North Dakota Senate from the 42nd district. She assumed office on December 2, 2024, succeeding Curt Kreun. Cory previously served as a member of the North Dakota House of Representatives for District 42 from 2019 to 2024.
